result.description: Compact studio interface for routing multiple MIDI sources and clock signals across a desktop music setup. Features 7 configurable DIN ports, USB-C host connection, per-port activity indicators, and selectable merge/split modes for sequencers, drum machines, and synth racks. Powered by external 9V adapter and designed for low-latency synchronization in small production environments.
result.title: Auralis TideLink 7-Port MIDI Hub
result.title_description: Studio MIDI routing hub with 7 DIN ports
